forge: Bring Brannoc 4 copper ore and 2 oak logs. Copper rock lies in the Meadows and the Scar; oaks grow everywhere.
line: Bring Old Tam 3 raw trout. Fish where ripples show on the river.
Cook a trout on the Fisher's fire and bring it to Old Tam.
poach: Defeat 3 bandits or poachers in Greywood.
Return to Warden Isolde at the end of the forest road.
mire: Bring Sister Wren 3 bogroot from Mirefen. Foraging 20 is needed to pick it.
Go to the Mire shrine at the end of the south-west road.
Defeat a Mire Hexer. Dodge its bolts, or parry at the last instant to send one back.
Return to Sister Wren in Hearthvale.
oath: Walk the north road to the gate of the Ashgrave.
Find the broken altar in the Old Ruins, north-east beyond the river.
Return to Elder Maren by the hearth.
